pli-tv-bu-vb-sk71:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pacchato gacchantā purato gacchantassa dhammaṃ desenti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk71:1.3.1: na pacchato gacchanto purato gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk71:1.4: na pacchato gacchantena purato gacchantassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk71:1.5: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca pacchato gacchanto purato gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
